title: School administration
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Use the school's own staff chart; titles vary (Board of Management, Parents Association). Name posts, not people.

skills.key_step: The child names school leaders (headteacher, deputy, senior teachers, class teachers, Board of Management, prefects) and gives each one's duty.

floor.prerequisite: Knows who is in the Children's Government.
floor.question: Who chooses the Children's Government?

representations: a visit from the deputy headteacher
contexts: the class teacher marking the register
the BOM meeting about a new classroom

board.say: What does the class teacher do?

board.do: Wait for "looks after the class and the register".

misconceptions.ask: Who is in charge of the whole school?
misconceptions.repair: Ask who is in charge on a day when both are present and who helps.

misconceptions.ask: Who takes the class register each morning?
misconceptions.repair: Match each duty to the person whose desk or room it is done at.

misconceptions.ask: Who is on the Board of Management?
misconceptions.repair: Show the school's BOM list (posts only) and count who are not teachers.

misconceptions.ask: Are the school cook and the guard part of the school community?
misconceptions.repair: List what would happen if there were no cook or guard for a week.

checks.question: Who acts as the head of the school when the headteacher is away?
Who marks the class register every morning?

skills.key_step: The child puts school leaders in order of authority and says who reports to whom.

floor.prerequisite: Names school leaders and their duties.
floor.question: What does the headteacher do?

representations: an empty chart to fill in
string showing who reports to whom
steps: Place the headteacher at the top of the staff.
Then senior teachers and class teachers.
contexts: a prefect reporting a broken desk
a class teacher reporting to the deputy
the head reporting to the BOM

board.do: Draw an empty chart of four levels.

board.say: Who goes at the top of the school staff?

board.do: Fill the levels with the child.

misconceptions.ask: On a school chart, who is placed directly under the headteacher?
misconceptions.repair: Draw the chart from the top down, one level at a time.

misconceptions.ask: Who reports to the class teacher?
misconceptions.repair: Ask who gives prefects their duties.

misconceptions.ask: Who has more authority in the school: the class teacher or the headteacher?
misconceptions.repair: Trace on the chart who the class teacher reports to.

misconceptions.ask: How do parents take part in running a school?
misconceptions.repair: Show the date of the next parents' meeting and what it decides.

checks.question: Put in order from the top: class teacher, headteacher, deputy headteacher.
Does a prefect rank above a teacher?
